name: config_io
root: Configuration import / export: round-trip the configuration to XML. import_configuration_from_xml and import_configuration_from_binary mutate the workspace (each creates a project) and export_object, import_configuration_from_binary and export_infobase_objects may reply Pending with a runKey to resume - the facade only routes, it adds no dryRun. export_configuration_to_cf dumps the infobase's current configuration (run update_database first to capture project changes); export_infobase_objects reads the infobase's own configuration and writes the Designer-XML files to a destination directory; export_database_configuration and export_database_extension are the guarded .cf/.cfe dumps - they refuse an occupied outputPath (overwrite=true overrides) and an infobase that does not hold the project's current configuration (allowOutOfSync=true overrides), so an old file can never pass as the result.

descriptions.operation: export_configuration_to_xml / import_configuration_from_xml / import_configuration_from_binary / export_object / export_common_picture / export_configuration_to_cf / export_infobase_objects / unpack_external_binary / export_database_configuration / export_database_extension / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like exportObject accepted). topic=<operation>: what that one takes.
descriptions.topic: Help topic when operation=help; without it - all operations with one-line summaries.
descriptions.find: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.
descriptions.extensionName: import_configuration_from_binary, .cfe only: name to load the extension under; if omitted, taken from the file name. export_database_extension: exact extension name to export (required; list_extension shows installed names).
descriptions.baseConfigurationPath: import_configuration_from_binary, .cfe only: .cf loaded into the staging infobase first, providing the configuration the extension borrows from.
descriptions.keepXmlPath: import_configuration_from_binary: keep the intermediate Designer-XML here instead of a temporary directory that is deleted.
descriptions.projectName: EDT project name; for import operations, the NEW project to create - must not exist.
descriptions.outputPath: Absolute output path, required by every export. export_configuration_to_xml: Designer-XML dump directory (created if missing; existing contents overwritten). export_object: .epf/.erf file path (extension picks the kind, else auto-detected). export_common_picture: FILE path, or DIRECTORY when allVariants=true. export_configuration_to_cf: .cf file path. export_infobase_objects: DIRECTORY path (must be absent or empty). export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: .cf / .cfe file path - existing file refused unless overwrite=true.
descriptions.objects: export_infobase_objects: required object addresses from the INFOBASE's configuration - a whole top object (Catalog.Банки / Справочник.Банки), a form (Catalog.Банки.Form.ФормаЭлемента) or a common form (CommonForm.Имя).
descriptions.importPath: import_configuration_from_xml: absolute path to the directory of Designer-XML files (required).
descriptions.sourcePath: unpack_external_binary: absolute path to the .epf or .erf file to convert (required).
descriptions.targetPath: unpack_external_binary: directory the XML is written into (required).
descriptions.applicationId: export_configuration_to_cf / export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: infobase application id (from get_applications).
descriptions.overwrite: export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: replace an existing file at outputPath (default false - occupied path refused).
descriptions.allowOutOfSync: export_database_configuration / export_database_extension: dump while the infobase lacks the project's current configuration (default false - the dump is refused instead of silently missing changes; run update_database first).
descriptions.skipValidation: export_configuration_to_cf: pass 'true' to skip the built-in validate_for_export guard.
descriptions.baseProjectName: Both imports, for an extension: the project of the configuration it extends.
descriptions.xmlVersion: import_configuration_from_xml: platform XML format version (e.g. 8.3.20); omit to auto-detect.
descriptions.objectName: export_object: object name within the project.
descriptions.timeoutSeconds: export_object: soft timeout in seconds before returning Pending JSON with runKey (default 30, range 5-120, clamped); same for import_configuration_from_binary (staging run) and export_infobase_objects (Designer run).
descriptions.runKey: export_object, import_configuration_from_binary, export_infobase_objects: resume a Pending run; other params ignored once runKey is supplied.
descriptions.name: export_common_picture: required CommonPicture name - 'CommonPicture.<Name>' or bare '<Name>'.
descriptions.variant: export_common_picture, multi-variant only: one DPI tier by manifest entry name (e.g. '200.png'), bare scale ('200') or screenDensity token ('hdpi').
descriptions.allVariants: export_common_picture, multi-variant only: extract every zip entry into outputPath as a directory (default false).
